name: RAYGUN
old_description: New releases, jokes, sales ... honestly, this is the best newsletter you'll get.
about:
RAYGUN operates from Des Moines, Iowa. According to company records, the business traces its origins to 1857, though the current retail brand appears to be a more recent incarnation. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company runs an e-commerce storefront specializing in Des Moines and Iowa-themed apparel and accessories. Its catalog spans t-shirts, hoodies, hats, mugs, stickers, tote bags, pint glasses, and enamel pins. Designs reference local landmarks such as the Iowa Capitol and East Village, as well as collegiate partners including Drake University, Iowa State University, and the University of Iowa. The store also carries pride-themed items and humorous slogans like "Des Moines Hates Nazis" and "Des Moines Is Pretty Gay."

RAYGUN sells directly to consumers through its website and offers a pickup option for local customers. Its audience includes Des Moines residents, university alumni, visitors seeking souvenirs, and fans of Midwest culture. The product mix targets both casual wear and gift markets, with price points ranging from $2.90 for stickers to $49 for hoodies.

The brand promotes a no-questions-asked return policy covering product cost and shipping without restocking fees, and highlights a newsletter described as "the greatest newsletter in the Universe" featuring new releases, jokes, and sales.
built_on: No-restocking-fee returns covering product and shipping costs
Local pickup available for Des Moines customers
Extensive catalog of Des Moines and Iowa-themed designs
Collegiate licensing for Drake, Iowa State, and University of Iowa
